profile.username_none: Not set. It is optional: c4rsys ID is enough for invitations.

rights.cash_accounts_hint: Only the ticked ones; if none is ticked, all of them.
rights.none: No rights: the employee will only see the company.

setup.cash_optional: A cash desk is not required to finish the setup, but it is needed to receive money.
setup.complete_needs_ready: Available when at least one context is ready.
setup.employees_text: Optional: you can work without employees and invite them later.
setup.hint_check: What is ready and what still needs setup.
setup.hint_finance: Choose the main currency; add a cash desk.
setup.hint_location: A location with a time zone and at least one context.
setup.hint_vehicle: A vehicle with the tariff and its terms.

setup.missing_no_vehicle: Add a vehicle allowed for rental here
setup.missing_no_vehicle_with_tariff: Assign the tariff to a vehicle
setup.ready_for_first: Everything is ready for the first rental.
setup.tariff_text: Create a daily tariff with price ranges.
setup.vehicle_text: Add a vehicle to the location and assign the tariff with mileage and deposit terms.

tariffs.name: Name
tariffs.no_vehicles: The tariff is not assigned to any vehicle.

tariffs.day_boundary_hint: Local time of the issue location; a part of a settlement day counts as a whole day.
tariffs.unit_fixed: The unit does not change after creation.

timezones.America/Mexico_City: Mexico City, Guatemala City, San José

vehicles.catalog_later: The catalog of makes for this type comes later — enter the make and model as text.
vehicles.contexts_hint: Any vehicle of the company can be serviced. Only an own vehicle is transferred to the warehouse — by a separate operation, with the warehouse module.
vehicles.in_warehouse: The vehicle is on the warehouse of «{{location}}» as a stock item; rental and moves are not available.
vehicles.match_plate: This plate in this country is already on another vehicle — a reason to check the data.
vehicles.match_vin: This VIN is already on another vehicle in the system — a reason to check the data.
vehicles.missing_location_without_rental_context: the location has no rental context
vehicles.missing_rental_not_allowed: rental is not allowed for the vehicle
vehicles.name: Name
vehicles.name_auto_hint: Formed from the make, model and plate; can be changed manually.
vehicles.name_hint: For example make, model and plate.
vehicles.none: No vehicles on this tab yet.
vehicles.own_only: The vehicle is created as own; the usage contexts existing in the company are switched on.
vehicles.owner_client_hint: A client vehicle is not bound to a location and is not used for rental or the warehouse; the location is given in the service operation (§ 8.1.2).
vehicles.owner_kind_client: A client from the client base
vehicles.owner_kind_profile: A c4rsys profile (ID, email or phone)
vehicles.owner_lookup: Owner's c4rsys ID, email or phone
vehicles.owner_lookup_hint: The company is not told whether such a profile exists. The confirmation request to the owner comes with the next task.
vehicles.owner_managed_hint: The owner data stay unconfirmed until the owner answers; this does not stop work with the vehicle (§ 8.3.3, § 8.3.13).
vehicles.tariffs_hint: Tariffs and their terms are assigned in the tariff card.
vehicles.transfer_no_warehouse: No location has a warehouse: add the «Warehouse» context to a location.
vehicles.transfer_text: No context is switched on for the vehicle. It can be transferred to a warehouse as the same asset — with its ID, characteristics and whole history; from the warehouse it is sold through an order.
vehicles.vin_hint: Usually 17 characters. An unusual VIN is saved with a warning.
vehicles.garage_text: The vehicle returns from the warehouse to the garage as the same vehicle: ID, characteristics, documents and history stay. Then rental or service can be allowed.
vehicles.acquisition_hint: For the payback of the vehicle. Payments for it and other expenses are payouts of the company linked to this vehicle.
vehicles.match_body_number: Another vehicle in the system has this body number — a reason to check the data.
vehicles.match_chassis_number: Another vehicle in the system has this chassis number — a reason to check the data.
vehicles.match_frame_number: Another vehicle in the system has this frame number — a reason to check the data.

warehouse.delete_hint: Only an item without movements can be deleted; otherwise archive it.
warehouse.external_id_hint: Your ID of the item — an import finds it again by it.
warehouse.import_by_name_unit: by name and unit — possible duplicate
warehouse.import_post_hint: Rows are checked again before posting; changed ones are marked as conflicts and not posted.
warehouse.import_template_hint: Fill in the «items» sheet of the template: the first row holds technical column codes, explanations are on the «help» sheet. Name and unit (piece, liter, kilogram, meter) are required.
warehouse.import_warning_repeated_file: This file was loaded before: loaded {{loaded}}, skipped {{skipped}}.
warehouse.name: Name
warehouse.no_storages: No warehouses: add the «Warehouse» context to a location.
warehouse.packagings_hint: How much material a packaging holds, in the base unit, to hundredths.
warehouse.parts_hint: Optional. An empty value means «Not given», not «fits everywhere»; universal use is set explicitly.
warehouse.search: Search by name, manufacturer or barcode
warehouse.toggles_hint: Both pressed — fits both (universal); none pressed — not given.
warehouse.unit_hint: The unit cannot be changed after creation.

warehouse.import_warning_row_code_unknown: Row {{number}}: code {{row}} is not of this import.

warehouse.import_warning_corrected_file: Corrected file: {{rows}} rows checked again. Choose actions and post.

warnings.payment_incomplete: The rental is not paid in full: {{amounts}} missing. It stays a debt of the order.
warnings.payment_not_checked: No planned end: the payment of the rental cannot be checked.
warnings.inspection_not_done: The required condition check was not done: a conflict is recorded.

counterparties.list_not_allowed: You may not view the list of counterparties.

receipts.supplier_hint: May stay «Not given»; add the supplier if it is not in the list.
receipts.initial_hint: Initial stock: no supplier is needed.
receipts.document_hint: Optional: an image or a PDF.
receipts.create_item: Not in the catalog — create an item
receipts.expected_hint: Optional; a difference is shown as a discrepancy.
receipts.unit_cost_hint: Empty — «Cost not given», it can be entered later.
receipts.lot_hint: May be added to a lot this warehouse already has.
receipts.lot_external_number: Lot number of the producer or supplier
receipts.lot_match: A lot with this number exists: {{lot}}. It may be the same one.
receipts.serial_numbers_hint: Optional, one per line. Each unit gets its own AST ID.
receipts.tags_hint: Comma separated, e.g. «Rack 3, shelf B». A hint where to look.
receipts.post_hint: A draft can be changed and deleted. Posting increases the stock by what was received.
receipts.draft_hint: The stock has not changed yet.
receipts.correction_hint: The original record stays. If the stock was already used by other operations, their numbers are shown.

purchases.hint: A purchase is made in advance and received in one or several receipts. Goods already bought are received directly with «New receipt».
purchases.cancel_hint: What was received and the history stay; the expected quantity goes down. A prepayment is settled separately.
purchases.payments_later: Payments to the supplier come with the finance section.

stock.title: Stock
stock.empty: No stock. Add it with «New receipt».
stock.item_empty: This item is not in stock.

operations.title: {{kind}} No. {{number}}
operations.hint_issue: Issue with a return possible: the issued can be returned or later marked as used.
operations.hint_consume: Actual use on a vehicle: the quantity leaves the stock, the cost goes to the vehicle.
operations.hint_move: What is sent is unavailable at the sender and appears at the receiver after receipt.
operations.hint_write_off: Written off leaves the stock; the record and history stay. A reason is required.
operations.hint_repack: Everything taken goes into new packages, loose rest or an explicit write-off of losses.
operations.vehicle_hint: Own and managed vehicles of the company.
operations.one_step: Send and receive at once (one action)
operations.lot_hint: The lot with the nearest expiry comes first, then the earliest.
operations.open_hint: A partial package is opened; its rest is kept apart.
operations.confirm_expired: Lot {{lot}} is expired. I confirm issuing it.
operations.issue_actions_hint: Enter quantities or tick units, then return them or mark them as used.
operations.receive_hint: Enter what was actually received. Empty — all received; an unticked unit is not received. A shortage stays until settled.
operations.settle_hint: Choose a reason to write the shortage off.
operations.repack_loss_hint: Losses are written off with a reason; never automatically.
operations.expired_policy: Expired lots at issue and use

inventory.hint: An inventory covers chosen items of one warehouse, which keeps working. The count changes no stock.
inventory.title: Inventory No. {{number}}
inventory.count_hint: The book stock is taken at the moment the found quantity is entered; closed packages are counted whole.
inventory.hint_found_unit: After the surplus is confirmed, a unit card and a receipt are created (cost not given).
inventory.hint_found_elsewhere: No new card: after a check, make a move or a correction.
inventory.hint_found_vehicle: The finding is only recorded: the vehicle is created in the garage and transferred to the warehouse.
inventory.decision_hint: On confirmation the discrepancies are applied to the current stock. On rejection the stock stays.

prices.title: Selling prices
prices.own_hint: A unit's own price is used over the item's price; the purchase cost stays.
prices.to_lots_hint: The current prices of each packaging and of loose sale go to every lot; then each can be changed.
prices.to_item: Switch to prices of the item
prices.to_item_hint: State the new prices explicitly — no average is used.
prices.snapshot_hint: A changed price applies to new additions to orders; lines already added keep their price.
prices.minimum_hint: Below the threshold the item is marked in the stock. Empty — no threshold; no purchase is created automatically.

sales.new_order_hint: Choose a client — an order is created, then add goods to it. No client — create one in «Contacts».
sales.open_orders: Or add to an open order of a client
sales.cancel_hint: The goods return to the warehouse, the charge is corrected; a payment becomes an overpayment.
sales.hint: Added goods are reserved at once at the fixed price; the sale happens when the order closes. A removed line releases the reserve.
sales.form_hint: Closed packages sell whole; loose sale comes from loose material or an opened package.
sales.reopen_title: Cancel the closing of the order
sales.reopen_hint: The order opens for corrections; they need their own rights, then the order is closed again.

returns.title: Return to the supplier
returns.hint: Only what this receipt brought goes back. A refund, a smaller debt or a replacement is settled separately.

dashboard.title: Dashboard «Warehouse»
dashboard.partial: calculated over the warehouses available to you only

categories.hint: The category is chosen by the name; it can be changed or removed.
categories.note_hint: The earlier text category, kept as a note.

rates.stale: The rate is outdated: check it or enter one by hand.
rates.none: There is no rate for this pair.
rates.none_since: There is no rate for this pair; rates were last updated {{time}}.
rates.no_right: Without the right to change the rate the operation cannot be posted; postpone it.
rates.manual_hint: Leave empty to apply the suggested rate.

settlements.none: Nobody owes and nothing is owed.
settlements.balance_hint: Balance = available funds − unpaid charges. A prepayment does not pay an order by itself: set it off below.
settlements.payable_hint: Received goods − settled returns − payments ± initial debts. Negative — prepaid.
settlements.incomplete: cost of some goods is not given
settlements.debt_will_appear: The closed order will owe {{debt}} {{currency}}. Confirm?
settlements.offset_hint: Lowers the funds and the debt by the same amount; no money is received again.
settlements.link_hint: Without a receipt — a prepayment or payment on account.
settlements.opening_hint: For the start of accounting in c4rsys: no money moves, no old order is needed. Old deposits go to the client's balance.
settlements.debtor_company_client: Advance: the company holds the client's money
settlements.entry_opening_company: Initial debt of the company / advance

corrections.reverse_hint: An opposite record cancels this one; both stay in history.
corrections.reverse_transfer_hint: The transfer is reversed on both accounts.
corrections.split_hint: Parts add up to the expense; the payout stays one.
corrections.unlink: Without an order (funds of the client)
corrections.change_client_hint: Only to fix a mistake: the previous client stays in history. The payment must not be linked to orders.

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.not_required: No deposit by the rental's terms.
deposit.term_manual: not set: moved only by hand
deposit.hint_to_balance: Moves the deposit to the client's balance before the term; no money moves.
deposit.hint_hold: This part is not moved by the term until the claim ends.
deposit.hint_release: The part is moved by the term again.
deposit.hint_offset: Pays a debt of an order from the deposit, not above the debt.
deposit.hint_refund: Pays the deposit back from a cash desk or account.
deposit.hint_waive: Ends the missing-deposit conflict; money received does not change.
deposit.vehicle_with_client: The vehicle is still with the client — refund anyway

bookings.title: Booking No. {{number}}
bookings.free: The vehicle is free for this period.
bookings.busy: The vehicle is taken in this period:
bookings.details_later: Everything here may be filled in later: without a client the booking is saved with «client not specified».
bookings.client_missing: Client not specified: the vehicle is held, the client must be chosen before the issue.
bookings.delay_overdue: The vehicle is still in an overdue rental (planned end {{end}}): it cannot be issued until it is returned.
bookings.delay_planned: The current rental of the vehicle is planned to end after this booking starts ({{end}}).
bookings.vehicle_elsewhere: The vehicle is now in another location: {{place}}. It must be moved before the issue.
bookings.tariff_kept: Empty — the current tariff stays if the new vehicle has it.
bookings.no_calculation: No tariff yet — the cost is calculated once a tariff is chosen.
bookings.policy_hint: A booking is cancelled automatically when the client has not come the set time after the planned start. Off by default. A booking keeps the rule it got when it was created.
bookings.deliveries_warning: The vehicle has trips in this period; the booking is kept, check the timing:

issue_rules.page_hint: Rules of the issue and auto-cancel of bookings: for the whole company, and a location may have its own.
issue_rules.location_failed: The device did not give its location: enter the address or coordinates.
issue_rules.place_hint: Fill in at least one: address, coordinates or comment. The place belongs to the chosen location and does not move the vehicle.
issue_rules.requirement_payment: Rental not paid in full: {{amounts}} missing
issue_rules.unmet_title: The issue policy is not met:
issue_rules.mode_advance: Permit the issue as an exception (I have the right)
issue_rules.mode_after_fact: The vehicle has already been handed over — record it; the exception will wait for confirmation
issue_rules.no_right: You have no right to permit an exception: ask an authorized employee, or record a transfer already made.
issue_rules.grant_hint: The issue of this booking may go without the chosen requirements. They stay unmet; the permission acts on one issue.
issue_rules.granted_on_booking: Permitted in advance on the booking: {{codes}}.
issue_rules.inspection_required_hint: The company requires the condition check: without the mark the issue goes on, and a conflict «check not done» is recorded.
issue_rules.policy_hint: Insufficient deposit and a missing inspection never block the issue: they give a conflict. The documents requirement starts to act with the documents module.

charges.free_hint: The vehicle stays occupied; free time only reduces the billable time. It must lie inside the rental: before the return — up to the planned end, without it — up to now.
charges.mileage_after_return: The overage is calculated when both readings are known.
charges.fuel_differs_hint: Fuel at return differs from the issue. The system does not turn it into money: charge it here if needed.

services.title: Additional services
services.pricing_fixed: Payment, unit and currency do not change after creation.
services.currency_hint: The service has its own currency; empty — the main currency of the company.
services.scope_hint: Nothing selected — no limit. Within one list any of the selected fits; a standalone service is checked by its location only.
services.unlink_hint: The service then has its own period and its own start and completion in the same order.
services.none_applicable: No services of the catalog fit this rental.
services.linked_hint: A linked service has the period of the rental and is charged together with it at the return.
services.location_hint: The revenue of the service belongs to it.

changes.extend_hint: Extend, shorten or set the planned end. The order is charged by the planned period.
changes.overdue_cost: The rental is overdue: the order holds the planned period, the card shows the cost up to now; the return recalculates it.
changes.tariff_hint: The new tariff applies from the start of the rental. The required deposit stays as agreed.
changes.services_not_allowed: Some linked services are not allowed by the current tariff: unlink or cancel them if needed.
changes.reopened: The rental is reopened: correct it and complete the formalization again.

rental_order.transfer_hint: The rental keeps its history; its charges and linked services go with it. Payments stay in the old order: relink them in finance.
rental_order.annul_hint: For a rental entered by mistake: its charges and those of its linked services go to zero; the place of the vehicle is not changed.

service.no_works: No works in the catalog yet.
service.system_work_hint: The choice links the work to the system one; leave empty for your own work
service.own_rate_hint: Empty — the rate of the location or the company
service.rates_hint: Chosen in this order: rate of the work → of the location → of the company. An empty value removes the rate.
service.posts_hint: Posts are optional: without a post the vehicle is in the general service zone.
service.no_locations: No location has the service context.
service.to_existing_order: The operation is added to this order
service.works_later: May be added after the diagnostics
service.blocker_service_price_missing: A done work has no price: set a price or zero, otherwise the order does not close.
service.accept_hint: The acceptance does not start the works: each work is started by its executor.
service.finish_hint: Every work needs a result: done, cancelled or terminated. The post and the general zone are freed.
service.terminate_hint: Works not started are cancelled, started ones are terminated; set their price separately.
service.cancel_hint: It may be cancelled while no work has started.
service.zero_hint: 0 — free of charge; not the same as «price not set»
service.blocker_service_materials_unsettled: Issued parts are not settled: mark them used or return them to the warehouse.
service.contractor_cost_hint: What the company owes the contractor; the client's price is separate
service.maintenance_hint: The next service counts from the last done work of the rule; «required» does not block a rental.
service.rule_work_hint: Linked works restart the count automatically
service.rule_base_hint: Without done works: the last execution or the first coming service, if known. It does not create a work.
service.blocker_service_act_missing: No act of completed works: the order will not close.
service.blocker_service_act_not_signed: The act is not signed by the client: the order will not close.

trips.other_hint: An address in the context of the vehicle's location; it does not change the binding
trips.in_order: The delivery is added to this order
trips.internal_hint: Without an order the trip goes to an internal order of the company.
trips.title: Trip No. {{number}}
trips.price_override_hint: Empty — the catalog price; another price needs the right
trips.later_operations: Operations began on the vehicle after this trip; annul or correct them first:

documents.title: Title
documents.file_hint: PDF, DOCX, XLSX up to 2 MB; photos JPEG, PNG, WebP up to 5 MB
documents.no_links: Not linked: in the registry only.
documents.no_own_templates: No own templates yet: copy a starting one and edit it.
documents.content_hint: # heading, - list item, **bold**, empty line — new paragraph; fields are put from the list below
documents.required_hint: Without data in a required field the document is not made
documents.methods_paper: Only on paper with a scan
documents.send_replaces: It replaces version {{number}}: unused links to it are revoked, received signatures stay.
documents.no_candidates: No one to choose: link a client or a counterparty, or give an employee the right to sign.
documents.code_hint: Sent to the email of your profile
documents.no_email_in_card: No email in the card: add one to send a link.
documents.link_code_hint: To sign or decline, confirm with a code sent to {{email}}.
documents.link_answer_signed: The document is signed. Thank you.
documents.link_answer_declined: You declined to sign. The company is told.
documents.requirements_hint: A document counts when it is linked to the rental. At the issue an absent one is handled by the policy «Documents»; at the return it keeps the formalization from completing.
documents.service_act_hint: The act is a document of the kind «Act» linked to the service. An internal order needs no act.
documents.service_act_required: A client's order with service is not closed without the act
documents.service_act_signed: The act is signed by the client
documents.show_to_client_hint: Show to the client (in the personal cabinet of the linked client)

tasks.title: Title
tasks.due_hint: Without a time — the end of the day
tasks.note: What it waits for / why paused
tasks.policy_release: The executor may return a task to the queue
tasks.policy_change_due: The executor may change the deadline of an own task
tasks.checklist_required: All items must be done for completion
tasks.no_tags: No tags in the company yet
tasks.groups_and_tags: Groups and tags of the company
tasks.repeat_hint: Starts from the deadline date; it is required
tasks.title_following: Title of this and the following
tasks.system_rental_exception_pending: Confirm or reject the issue exception
tasks.system_finance_debt: Collect the debt of the order

notifications.event_document_term: The term of the document № {{number}} «{{title}}» ends on {{valid_until}}
notifications.event_employee_access_changed: Your access in the company has changed
notifications.event_document_signing_result: Answer on the signing of the document № {{number}} «{{title}}»
notifications.event_rental_exception_pending: An issue exception waits for a decision (booking № {{booking_number}}, {{vehicle}})
notifications.event_rental_inspection_missing: A returned rental has no saved inspection: {{vehicle}}
notifications.rule_rental_inspection_missing: Missing inspection before closing a rental

imports.title: Import from XLSX
imports.hint_items: Fill the «items» sheet: technical codes in the first row, explanations on «help». Name and unit (piece, liter, kilogram, meter) are required.
imports.hint_vehicles: Fill the «vehicles» sheet. Required: location ID (sheet «locations»), relation own or managed, odometer unit km or mi, and a name — given or formed from make, model, plate or VIN.
imports.hint_clients: Fill the «clients» sheet. Required: type person or company; for a person first and last name, for a company its name; at least one phone or email. A c4rsys ID sends no request.
imports.hint_counterparties: Fill the «counterparties» sheet. Matches are searched among counterparties only; a client with the same contacts does not count.
imports.no_right: You need the right to import and the right to add records of this section.
imports.id_conflict: The ID points to one card, other identifiers to another: link or skip
imports.by_name_unit: by name and unit — possible duplicate
imports.correction_hint: The file for correction has the rows not loaded with their codes; the reasons are on the «problems» sheet. Rows are matched by code, their order may change; loaded rows are not posted again.
imports.lot_group: New lot «{{code}}»: its rows are loaded only together
imports.packaging_missing: New packaging {{quantity}} {{unit}} ({{name}}): it is created only after your confirmation
imports.by_lot_external_number: by the external lot number — possibly an existing lot
imports.hint_stock: Initial stock: one row per unit of an individual item; a material by lots — a new lot by its code in the file, an existing one by its LOT ID; closed packages, an opened package with its rest, or loose material. The IDs of items, warehouses and lots are on the sheets of the template.

links.title: Link with a c4rsys profile
links.not_linked: The card is not linked with a profile: the client does not see its history. Check the contact and send a request if needed.
links.no_sms: No message is sent to a phone yet: tell the client to register with this number or send the request by ID or email.
links.target_person: USR ID, email or phone of the client
links.hint_person: The client confirms the link and chooses which data to give. Without a profile with this email the client gets an invitation to register.
links.hint_company: The company's director or an employee with the right answers the request.
links.shared_hint: Given by the client when accepting. They do not change the card by themselves: take a value into the working data if needed.
links.break_confirm: Break the link? The history given before stays with the client; new operations are no longer shown to them.
links.incoming_title: Requests to link with the company
links.asks_client: The company asks to link its client card with this profile. After accepting you will see the allowed history of your orders, rentals, service and purchases with it.
links.asks_counterparty: The company asks to link its counterparty card with this profile.
links.consent: Accepting is consent to give the chosen data. Later changes of your profile are not sent to this company.

owner_requests.title: Confirmation by the owner
owner_requests.conflict: Conflict: the owner refused the link or the management. You can keep working with the vehicle.
owner_requests.profile_needed: To send a request give the owner by USR ID, email, phone or CMP ID.
owner_requests.dispute: The vehicle already has another confirmed owner: ownership is not changed automatically, the case is for the c4rsys support.
owner_requests.send: Send a request to the owner
owner_requests.asks: The company named you the owner of this vehicle. Each answer is separate:
owner_requests.ask_link: Do you confirm the link with this company? «Yes» makes you its client: the company gets your name and email.
owner_requests.ask_ownership: Is this vehicle yours? «Yes» adds it to your personal garage.
owner_requests.ask_management: Do you agree that this company manages the vehicle?
owner_requests.final: An answer cannot be changed later: a new decision needs a new request of the company. You may answer some questions now and the rest later.

cabinet.title: Personal cabinet
cabinet.no_companies: No company is linked with your profile yet. A company sends a request; you confirm it here.
cabinet.broken_hint: The link is broken: you see the history shared before; new operations are not shown.
cabinet.get_code: Get a code to sign or decline
cabinet.garage_hint: A vehicle appears here after you confirm its ownership at the request of a company.

exports.title: Full data export
exports.hint: A ZIP archive: a CSV table for each kind of records with their IDs and the IDs of related records, and the files of the documents you may view. The download link works 24 hours and needs your sign-in and the right to export.
exports.expired: The link has expired; prepare a new export.
